properties.name: Pacific Ocean (GOaS)
properties.source: Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions, Global Oceans and Seas v1
components: South China and Easter Archipelagic Seas
properties.note: The union of GOaS's North and South Pacific, plus its 'South China and Easter [sic] Archipelagic Seas' (the South China Sea and the Indonesian seas, which GOaS keeps as a region of their own). 60S to the Bering Strait; the Atlantic boundary runs through Panama and down Cape Horn's meridian, so the Gulf of Mexico, the Caribbean and Hudson Bay are out. GOaS cuts the ocean at the antimeridian; the western-hemisphere halves were shifted +360 and unioned, so longitudes run continuously on the 0-360 frame. Interior rings dropped (land inside the region is excluded by sst_daily holding ocean cells only).
